caption: The drawing depicts a single round metal trivet with three legs and a long handle, executed in grayscale pencil or charcoal on a plain, light background. The trivet is composed of an outer circular rim with three straight supports spanning its diameter, inside of which are two squiggly, serpentine bars running parallel to each other. One leg is angled toward the viewer’s left, while the other two legs extend downward and to the right. The handle, which is an extension of the metal rim, projects from the right side of the circle, is relatively straight, and ends with a small upturned hook. The bottom right area of the drawing contains a handwritten signature that reads “Maurice Van Felix.”
title: Gridiron
